summary: Iteration 8 — Full E2E of new Audits tab (frontend + backend). 12/12 backend tests passed (pytest) and 22/22 frontend Playwright assertions passed. All acceptance criteria verified: nav-audits present, nav-offers removed, AUD-0001 seed visible, auto-gen codes (AUD-0002/AUD-0003, RPT-2026-00X), custom codes stored as typed, edit updates total + live outstanding, Pay modal titled 'Record Audit Payment' with audits (not projects) in dropdown, audit-payment creation updates received/outstanding correctly (AUD-0001: 25K->35K received, 25K->15K outstanding), invoice PDF 200+application/pdf, archive/restore, search, sort, delete with forceVerify password modal, /offers route doesn't crash app.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from RecordPaymentModal.jsx L79. formatINR() returns a <span> which is rendered inside <option>. Not breaking functionality, but should be fixed — call e.g. p.outstanding_amount raw or use a formatter that returns a string (not JSX) inside <option>. Same warning likely existed in project path too.

action_items: (Minor) Fix <span>-inside-<option> hydration warning in RecordPaymentModal.jsx — formatINR returns JSX, use a plain-string formatter when injecting into <option> children.

(Informational) AUD-0001 seed is now at ₹35K received / ₹15K outstanding after my test payment of ₹10K (seed_data only adds the initial ₹25K if received_amount == 0 on a fresh seed). If user expects the original 25K/25K seed demo state, main agent can manually reset via: db.audit_payments.delete_many + db.audits.update_one({'audit_code':'AUD-0001'},{'$set':{'received_amount':25000,'outstanding_amount':25000,'status':'Outstanding'}}) and re-insert the single 25K demo payment.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend _next_audit_code / _next_report_id correctly skip when user provides custom codes (server.py lines ~1182-1200). Verified via pytest + UI.
Audit model + _audit_to_project_shape adapter cleanly reuses project PDF builder — good DRY.
RecordPaymentModal.jsx uses entityType='audit' prop, switches URLs and labels — clean, minimal duplication.
Minor: RecordPaymentModal <option> children include <span> from formatINR causing React hydration warning. Non-blocking.
AuditsPage handleDelete correctly uses window.confirm + forceVerify chain, matching other modules.
Auto-gen next-code logic produces AUD-0002, AUD-0003 sequentially (confirmed live).
